OpenAI released GPT-5 on August 7, 2025 [Source: ev-1]. The release marked a strategic shift to "give-away-the-frontier" pricing by making the model available immediately to free users [Source: ev-1]. This change ended the previous separation between reasoning and non-reasoning models; specific o-series products like o3, o4-mini, o3-mini, and o3-pro were retired and folded into GPT-5's internal "reasoning modes," resulting in a single unified model without a separate model picker [Source: ev-1].

The company’s sales approach changed through aggressive price collapse and simplified access. While Plus remains at $20/month for unlimited use and Pro is $200/month, API prices dropped significantly to $1.25 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens for GPT-5 (and $0.25/$2 for GPT-5 mini) [Source: ev-1]. This strategy moved the competitive focus from benchmark demos to becoming the default agency that acts rather than just answers [Source: ev-1].
